report: humanize.naturaltime(datetime.timedelta(days=365 * 2.6)) returns '2 years ago'; 2.6 years should round to '3 years ago'.
issue_test:
import datetime as dt

import humanize


def test_naturaltime_2_6_years():
    assert humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(days=365 * 2.6)) == "3 years ago"
hidden_tests:
import datetime as dt

import humanize


def test_years_round_to_nearest():
    assert humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(days=365 * 4.7)) == "5 years"
    assert humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(days=365 * 10.5 + 10)) == "11 years ago"
    assert humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(days=365 * 1141.8)) == "1,142 years"
    assert humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(days=-365 * 7.8)) == "8 years from now"
